theorem.name: SEQUENTIAL_RAW_BUDGET_CERTIFICATE_GUARANTEES_FROZEN_V3_PLAN
theorem.statement: In the root-free v3 tail with extension budget available, let M be a cap-admissible exact B2 macro for a frozen cooccurring pair candidate. If there exist distinct pre-macro live old pivots x,y such that the generic bound B_x(M)<=cap, exact elimination produces M_x with y still live, and B_y(M_x)<=cap, then the frozen v3 search contains an exact two-elimination plan with strict progress.
proof_summary: Generic raw-budget v1.1 guarantees the first raw-capped elimination.
Second-pivot liveness matches the frozen v3 transition grammar.
Generic raw-budget v1.1 guarantees the second raw-capped elimination.
Two distinct old variables disappear and at most one fresh extension variable is introduced, so final live-variable count is at most the pre-macro count minus one.
Root-free Phi equals live-variable count, hence progress is strict.
Frozen v3 deterministically enumerates the macro candidate and ordered old-pivot pair and independently replays the exact plan.

regression_evidence.note: Finite CI validates implementation/regression only; theorem status comes from the compositional proof.

remaining_open_gap.name: ALL_CANDIDATE_SEQUENTIAL_BUDGET_FAILURE
remaining_open_gap.definition: After earlier exact lanes, a genuine v3 availability witness must defeat every cap-admissible B2 macro candidate/order by first-bound failure, second-pivot disappearance, second-bound failure, or extension-budget unavailability. Bound failure alone is not proof that actual elimination would fail.

next_exact_target: Force existence of at least one sequentially budget-certified macro/order from aggregate incidence constraints, or produce a minimal reachable root-free witness that defeats all such certificates.
